newsitem.title: USA: Travelers Q4 oper shr rises.
newsitem.headline: Travelers Q4 oper shr rises.

text.p: Oper shr $0.92 $0.66
Year
Oper shr $3.35 $2.44
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: First Call consensus estimate was $0.89 a share.
Earnings per share results reflect a four-for-three stock split effective November 22, 1996 and a three-for-two split effective May 24, 1996.
Full year results also reflect the company's repurchase of about 17.3 million common shares in 1996, adjusted for splits, principally for employee benefit plans.
Q4 net income was $0.97 a share, or $643.3 million, versus $0.92 a share, or $606.9 million, in the year-ago period.

1996 Q4 net income results include operating earnings, reported investment portfolio gains of $60.6 million and net charges of $25.8 million, after minority interest, related to the acquisition of Aetna Inc's property-casualty operations.

1995 Q4 net income results include operating earnings, investment portfolio gains of $68.2 million and a net gain of $97.0 million resulting principally from the sale of The MetraHealth Cos -- a joint venture between Travelers and Metropolitan Life Insurance Co -- to United Healthcare Corp.
Net income for full year 1996 was $3.50 a share, or $2.331 billion, versus $2.76 a share, or $1.834 billion, in 1995.

1996 net income includes operating earnings, reported net investment portfolio gains of $27.4 million and charges related to the acquisition of Aetna's property-casualty operations of $346.4 million, after minority interest.

It also includes a $363.0 million gain from the Travelers/Aetna Property Casualty Corp initial public offering, a $30.7 million gain related to a contingency payment from the 1995 sale of MetraHealth, and a $25.9 million net gain from the disposition of investment advisory affiliates.
Net income in 1995 includes operating earnings, investment portfolio gains of $85.3 million and gains on sales of subsidiaries and affiliates of $117.0 million.
Travelers Group Inc.
